Hi Sarah / HorizonPay team,

Quick note from our side: overnight we observed a sustained p95 latency increase on requests routed to model "omega-sigma" version v3.2 serving your traffic in us-west-2. The deploy coincided with greater KV cache churn and a 2.4x increase in tail latency for sequences >512 tokens.

Impact we see:
- P95 for HorizonPay production routes jumped from ~160ms to ~540ms for a 30-minute window starting 2026-08-05T01:12:00Z.
- Error rate stayed low (0.2%) but timeouts and user-facing slow responses increased.
- Your SLAs (p95 250ms) are at risk for this model variant.

Immediate ask: we recommend activating a safety gate for HorizonPay traffic tied to model selection for the next 12 hours while we run a fast regression triage. Safety gate actions proposed (please authorize):
1) Pin HorizonPay to omega-sigma v3.1 for read traffic (lower quality but stable latency).
2) Apply a 40% traffic cap to v3.2 while autoscaling warms up.
3) Enable automatic fallback to the cached-response variant (v3.1-cache) for sequences >512 tokens.

We need explicit authorization from HorizonPay to trigger the traffic cap and pin strategy because this is a change to inferred quality/throughput. If you approve, we will:
- Push the safety gate and traffic cap within 15 minutes of your OK.
- Share perf snapshots and a rollback plan (attached).
- Log this as a provisional SLA exception window and propose a credit if p95 exceedance persists beyond the mitigation window.

Attachments: horizon_action_plan_v2.pdf (action plan + rollback steps); p95_snapshots_20260805-0800_to_20260807-1400.zip (perf dumps).

Thanks — I want to minimize user impact and keep you informed while our infra/serving teams investigate root cause.

— Kimberly
